learning_outcomes.text: Harmonious combination of physical education and sports discipline with intellectual activity.
Adaptation for systematic independent practice of physical exercise.
Formation of habits of discipline, punctuality, correctness.

assessment_rules: Minimum performance standard includes performing simple jogging exercises and active presence in classes (7 lessons/semester).
